user.title: Choose a scale
user.description: Pick the scale to set up. Scales marked untested are decoded from the vendor app but have not been tried on a real scale.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Body scale found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({model})? The scale is read passively from its Bluetooth advertisements.

untested.title: Untested scale type
untested.description: This scale type ({model}) hasn't been tested with a real scale yet. Its readings are decoded from the vendor app's protocol, so weights may be wrong or missing. If it doesn't work, open an issue and attach the integration's diagnostics download: it includes recent raw broadcasts from the scale.

person.title: Add a person
person.description: Add someone who uses the scale. You can add more people next, and change them later in the integration options.

data_description.notify_services: Services used to ask who stepped on the scale, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.

another_person.title: Person added
another_person.description: Add another person, or finish setting up the scale.

error.birth_date_in_future: Date of birth must be in the past.
error.notify_required: Select at least one notify service.
error.unknown_notify_service: One of the selected notify services does not exist.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported body scale found nearby. Step on the scale and try again.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported body scale.

data_description.notify_services: Services used to ask who stepped on the scale, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.

data_description.tolerance_kg: How close a reading must be to a person's last weight to match them (0.5 to 20 kg).
data_description.confirm_auto_assign: Send the matched person a notification with buttons to move the reading to someone else or undo it.

error.birth_date_in_future: Date of birth must be in the past.
error.notify_required: Select at least one notify service.
error.unknown_notify_service: One of the selected notify services does not exist.

assign_reading.name: Assign reading
assign_reading.description: Assigns a scale reading to a person. A reading that is already assigned is moved.

reading_id.name: Reading ID
reading_id.description: ID of the reading, as listed by the unassigned readings sensor or the measurement event.

discard_reading.name: Discard reading
discard_reading.description: Discards a scale reading, for example a guest's, whether or not it is assigned.

reading_id.name: Reading ID
reading_id.description: ID of the reading, as listed by the unassigned readings sensor or the measurement event.

missing_notify_service.title: Scale notification service {service} is missing
missing_notify_service.description: The body scale uses {service} to notify {people}, but it does not exist. Open the scale's Configure options and pick a working notify service, or reinstall the phone app if the service was removed.
